quote_zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将12.4g叔丁醇钾(95％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待叔丁醇钾分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为98.0％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
arithmetic_check: Charges: methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate 34.8 g at 98 percent strength and 0.1 mol. 34.8 x 0.98 = 34.10 g over 0.100 mol implies 341.0 against C10H10BrClO4S = 341.60, correct to 0.2 percent. Potassium tert-butoxide 12.4 g at 95 percent and 0.105 mol. 12.4 x 0.95 = 11.78 g over 0.105 mol implies 112.2 against C4H9KO = 112.21, exact. Both printed triples therefore close and molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised. Stoichiometry implied by the printed moles is 1.05 mol of base per mol of ester, which the text does not word, so molar_ratio_text is null and equivalents are left null rather than computed into the record. Product closure: NOT TESTABLE. The step prints no product mass and no yield, only an in-process normalised content of 98.0 percent for the potassium salt, and the material is carried forward without isolation. The absence of mass_balance_implausible on this record means the test could not be run, not that the step closed. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"reactions": [...]}] at line 412, a single-arrow scheme. Reactant COC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(CBr)c1Cl, C10H10BrClO4S, which is the methyl ester the prose charges. Arrow condition text C4H9OK, which is the potassium tert-butoxide the prose charges. Product CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[K+], C9H7BrClKO4S, the POTASSIUM benzoate the prose makes and assays. Reactant, reagent and product all agree with the prose, so no drawing_text_conflict is raised on this record. Read atom by atom the drawn product is 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate with a potassium counter-ion, that is, the compound the prose names, so this pass does not reproduce the SMILES_MISMATCH warning A1 left on the same compound; the two passes disagree and neither reading is silently dropped. tert-butanol is written in the procedure and drawn nowhere, but it is the solvent, not a reagent, so reagent_written_not_drawn is not raised. Nothing on this arrow is drawn and unwritten. The scheme of the NEXT step, at line 421, draws the SODIUM salt as the substrate of the etherification and therefore contradicts the potassium product drawn here; that conflict is flagged on Example 8_Step 3, where the contradicting drawing sits.

quote_zh: 向反应釜中加入100mL三氟乙醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入5.5g金属钾(99％，0.14mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经脱溶后得到三氟乙醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
arithmetic_check: Charges: potassium metal 5.5 g at 99 percent and 0.14 mol. 5.5 x 0.99 = 5.445 g over 0.140 mol implies 38.9 against the atomic weight of potassium, 39.10, correct to 0.5 percent, so molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised. Trifluoroethanol is printed as a volume only, 100 mL, with no mass, no strength and no mole count, so no mass and mole pair exists to test and no equivalence ratio is stated; the alcohol is plainly in large excess over the metal but no density is printed in the document and none is imported here. Product closure: NOT TESTABLE. No mass, no yield and no purity is printed for the isolated potassium alkoxide, so the absence of mass_balance_implausible on this record means the test could not be run, not that the step closed. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: NONE. The patent draws no arrow for the alkoxide preparation. The only drawing in this half of the example is the single-arrow scheme at line 421, which is the etherification: it carries CF3CH2OK as a condition ABOVE its arrow, that is, as a reagent already in hand, and neither potassium metal nor trifluoroethanol appears anywhere in it. This transformation is therefore written and never drawn, and both of its reagents are in the procedure and on no arrow, which is the basis for reagent_written_not_drawn on this record. There is consequently nothing that could disagree with the prose, so no drawing_text_conflict is raised here.

quote_zh: 向三氟乙醇醇钾中加入130mL乙腈，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在15℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(98.0％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为1h，加毕保温反应6h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.6g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为98.2％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.9％。
arithmetic_check: Charge: potassium 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate at 98.0 percent and 0.1 mol, printed with no mass, so there is no mass and mole pair to test on the substrate. The alkoxide is printed with no charge at all; the metal charge of the preceding step, 0.14 mol, is 1.4 times the substrate on the printed moles, so the alkoxide is in excess and the benzoate salt is limiting. Product closure: product 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid is C11H10ClF3O5S, MW 346.70. Limiting input 0.100 mol gives 34.67 g theoretical. Printed mass is 32.6 g, which is BELOW theory at 94.0 percent of it, so no product mass exceeds what the input moles could give. Taking the printed 98.2 percent content, the contained product is 32.6 x 0.982 = 32.01 g, which is 92.3 percent of theory on the nominal 0.1 mol. The patent prints 91.9 percent, stated as a TWO-STEP yield on the methyl ester of step (1), whose own charge was 0.1 mol at 98 percent. Printed yield and printed purity-corrected mass therefore agree to within 0.4 percentage points, or about 0.5 percent relative, which is rounding at this precision; solving the printed pair for a molecular weight gives 348.3 against the true 346.70, a gap of 1.6. This CLOSES. Neither mass_balance_implausible nor molar_mass_inconsistent is raised on this record. Note for A5: the 91.9 percent is a two-step figure and is stored in product_yield_pct because it is the only yield the section prints; it must not be read as the yield of this step alone. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"reactions": [...]}] at line 421, a single-arrow scheme. Reactant CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[Na+], C9H7BrClNaO4S, the SODIUM benzoate. Arrow conditions CF3CH2OK and HCl. Product CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, C11H10ClF3O5S, the free acid, which matches the name in the heading and in the prose. DISAGREEMENT: the drawn substrate is the sodium salt while the prose of this step charges the potassium salt prepared in step (1), the prose of step (1) makes the potassium salt, and the step (1) scheme at line 412 draws the potassium salt. The alkali metal of the substrate is thus drawn one way and written another, in the same example, and the drawing also contradicts the other drawing. Per rule 5c the structured fields keep the prose reading, potassium, and drawing_text_conflict is raised with both readings in notes. The arrow's own reagents agree with the prose in both directions: CF3CH2OK is the alkoxide made in the preceding paragraph and HCl is the concentrated acid of the workup, which is why the acid is recorded in workup rather than as a reagent of the substitution. Acetonitrile and the workup water are written and on no arrow, but they are solvents and not reagents, so reagent_written_not_drawn is not raised. Nothing on the arrow is drawn and unwritten.
